description:
LinkedIn Sales Navigator Advanced helps professionals organize prospect research and build a more focused sales workflow. This SEOGBTools offer is $40 for one month, with voucher activation and email invitation options for eligible accounts. Choose the appropriate method with support before ordering, especially if your LinkedIn account already has an active subscription. Activation is on your own private email. Our $40 offer saves approximately 75% compared with LinkedIn’s listed Advanced monthly starting price of $159.99 USD per license, excluding taxes and promotions. This is a comparison with the vendor’s listed price, not a claim about our previous selling price.

If you sell web development, SEO, design, consulting, or other business services, a prospecting tool can help you research suitable companies and decision-makers. It does not bring clients automatically. Your offer, profile, research, and quality of communication still matter. This page explains the plan, the activation choices, and a practical way to use a month of access without spending your time collecting unrelated leads.

What you are ordering

The product is LinkedIn Sales Navigator Advanced for a one-month period at $40. Two activation methods are offered: voucher activation and email invitation. The suitable method depends on account eligibility and current availability. Confirm the arrangement before checkout. This is a digital activation service; there is no physical software box or shipped package. Product artwork is illustrative.

SEOGBTools is an independent seller. This listing does not imply endorsement by LinkedIn or a direct purchase from LinkedIn. Features are controlled by LinkedIn and can vary with the account and subscription arrangement. The one-month description does not promise lifetime access, a permanent license, or automatic renewal. Check the order terms for the exact duration and renewal arrangement before paying.

What Sales Navigator Advanced includes

LinkedIn's published plan comparison describes Advanced as a prospecting and team collaboration plan. Its listed capabilities include lead and account research, saved lists, Buyer Intent, Smart Links, and collaboration features. LinkedIn also lists 50 monthly InMail credits per user across its Sales Navigator plans. Availability and account conditions remain subject to LinkedIn. Confirm any particular feature that your work depends on before ordering activation.

Advanced and Advanced Plus are different plans. Do not assume a full CRM integration is included because you see it mentioned elsewhere in the Sales Navigator range. The same applies to an old feature list or a competitor's product page. Compare the exact plan name and current entitlement, rather than choosing on the basis of a generic Premium label.

Voucher activation

Voucher activation uses the supplied redemption instructions for an eligible account. Before ordering, tell support whether you currently have a LinkedIn Premium or Sales Navigator subscription and whether you have used a related offer before. An offer's availability can depend on account history, region, and the specific voucher conditions. Do not assume every account will qualify in the same way.

Follow the instructions associated with your actual order. Review the plan name and the duration on the redemption screen before confirming anything. If the account shows a different plan or an unexpected charge, pause and contact support rather than continuing blindly. Keep your order reference so the seller can identify the activation you purchased and answer questions about that particular offer.

Email invitation activation

Email invitation is the second activation option. Provide the appropriate working email through the order or support process and check the invitation details before accepting. Make sure you use the LinkedIn account intended for the subscription. Confirm the plan and duration with support, and ask how the invitation affects an existing subscription if you already have one.

You should not send your password or one-time security codes through an ordinary support message. Use the normal account sign-in process where needed. An invitation and a voucher are different delivery methods, so their instructions should not be mixed. If you receive an unexpected invitation or cannot identify its connection to your order, ask support to clarify it before taking action.

Which activation method should you choose?

Choose the method that is suitable for your account and confirmed available for your order. A new account, an account with a previous trial, and an account with an active subscription may have different conditions. Tell support about the current subscription state without sharing secret credentials. This helps avoid choosing an offer that cannot be applied to the intended account.

Both methods are listed for this product, but that does not mean both will be used on the same purchase or that you receive two separate months. The offer is one month of Advanced access for $40 through the agreed method. Ask questions about eligibility before paying when the answer will determine whether the purchase suits you.

Find prospects for web development and SEO services

Start with a specific business segment. A web developer might focus on small ecommerce businesses that need a clearer mobile shopping experience. An SEO consultant might research companies with a defined service area and a relevant marketing team. Define the market, business size, and person likely to own the problem before building a lead list.

Avoid beginning with everyone who has founder in their title. A large unfocused list usually creates more review work and weaker messages. Write down the problem your service solves and the evidence you would need to see before contacting a company. Use research to decide whether the company is a reasonable fit rather than treating every result as a qualified customer.

Build a focused lead list

Use available search filters to narrow your research and review profiles individually. Save relevant people and companies into lists with clear purposes, such as local service businesses or ecommerce marketing contacts. Keep a short note explaining why each prospect fits. A name in a list is a research lead, not proof that the person wants your service.

Check the company website and the person's role before writing. A job title can change, and the person you first identify may not be responsible for your proposed project. Useful notes include the business context, a relevant public observation, and a question worth asking. Avoid adding personal assumptions or sensitive details that have no legitimate connection to the business conversation.

Make outreach relevant

A useful first message is short and grounded in the prospect's business. Explain why you are reaching out and ask a simple relevant question. For example, a developer may ask whether improving a specific shopping step is a current priority, provided the observation is accurate. Do not claim that you found errors you have not checked or promise revenue improvements without evidence.

Personalization means understanding the context, not merely inserting a first name into a template. Mention one genuine reason the company may be relevant to your offer, then give the recipient room to decline. Avoid aggressive sequences and repeated unsolicited messages. Respect platform rules, the person's response, and any request not to be contacted again.

Use InMail thoughtfully

InMail provides a way to contact people beyond your existing connections, subject to your plan's current allowance and LinkedIn's rules. Treat credits as a reason to prioritize carefully. Review the profile, understand the business, and write a message with a clear purpose. A monthly allowance does not mean that every available credit should be used on an unqualified contact.

Keep records of the message angle and the response so you can improve the process. If a message gets no useful replies, examine the audience and offer before sending more of the same. A prospecting tool can support research and communication, but it cannot guarantee replies, meetings, contracts, or a particular number of new clients.

Understand Buyer Intent and Smart Links

Buyer Intent and Smart Links are among the capabilities LinkedIn associates with Advanced. When available in your account, use them to support a more informed workflow rather than to make assumptions about a person's intentions. A business signal needs context. An interaction with content is not a commitment to purchase and should not be described as one.

If you share a proposal or resource, make it relevant to the discussion and check that you are allowed to share its contents. Do not expose confidential client work as a sales example without permission. Features that track engagement can support follow-up decisions, but the message should still be considerate and based on the actual relationship.

A practical one-month plan

Use the first few days to confirm activation and organize your profile, offer, and target audience. Make sure your profile explains what you do and gives a suitable prospect a reason to continue the conversation. Prepare a small portfolio or service explanation that matches the people you plan to contact. Access is more valuable when your own sales materials are ready.

Next, research a manageable set of companies and people. Review the results, save the strongest fits, and test a few thoughtful messages. Record the questions people ask and improve your offer where the same confusion appears repeatedly. Reserve time for replies and follow-ups rather than spending the entire month building lists that you never use.

Toward the end of the month, review what you learned. Consider the number of relevant conversations, the quality of the fit, and how much time the process required. Do not judge value only by the size of a saved list. A smaller list that leads to useful discussions may serve you better than a large collection of unrelated profiles.

Prepare useful material before you contact prospects

Create a short explanation of the service, who it suits, and what happens next. Use an example you can substantiate, and keep the scope understandable. For web development, explain the kind of site or improvement you handle. For SEO, distinguish research, technical work, content, and reporting so the buyer knows what your proposal actually covers.

If you need supporting website research, our Similarweb guide explains a separate competitor research workflow. For writing a clearer campaign or service page, see our Copymatic guide. These tools have different purposes and are separate purchases unless an offer explicitly says otherwise.

Questions before ordering

Is this Core or Advanced?

This listing is for Sales Navigator Advanced. Core is a separate plan, and Advanced Plus is another separate plan. Confirm the exact plan shown during activation. Do not proceed with a different product simply because it also carries the Sales Navigator name. If something does not match the order, contact support with the order reference.

Is the price $40 for one month?

Yes. The displayed SEOGBTools offer is $40 for one month. Review the final checkout amount and any displayed payment terms before completing payment. Do not assume a sale discount, a longer duration, or automatic renewal unless the actual order clearly includes it. Ask about renewal separately if you want to continue after the first month.

Will it work with an existing subscription?

Eligibility needs checking. Tell support which subscription is currently active and whether you have used a related offer previously. Do not cancel or change an existing subscription based only on a general description. Confirm the suitable activation route first and read any instructions shown by LinkedIn for your specific account.

Will I receive a physical box?

No. This is a digital activation product. The blue and white software-box artwork illustrates the service; no physical packaging is shipped. Follow the order instructions for the agreed voucher or email invitation method. Keep the order reference and check the activated subscription details after completing the process.

Does this guarantee clients?

No. Sales Navigator is a prospect research and sales workflow tool. Results depend on audience fit, your service, credibility, communication, and follow-through. Use it to improve the quality of your research and conversations. Avoid treating any seller's promotional claim as a guarantee of income, automatic leads, or successful contracts.

How to order

Confirm account eligibility and your preferred activation method, then use Buy Now to open the SEOGBTools member checkout for this product. Review the one-month duration and $40 offer before paying. Follow the digital delivery instructions provided for your order. Once activated, check the plan name and subscription details inside your LinkedIn account, and contact support if they do not match the agreed service.

Product capabilities are described using LinkedIn's official plan comparison. Features and eligibility remain subject to LinkedIn. SEOGBTools is an independent provider; product names belong to their respective owners. Reviewed 8 November 2026.
